# harborpilot_gateway_token (Ephemeral Resource)

Issues a gateway token for a client binding while Terraform runs and, by default, revokes it afterwards. Requires Terraform 1.10 or later. Use it to pass a token to another provider or a write-only argument without storing it in state.

It can issue a parent token: set `scopes` to include `tokens:mint` and `revoke_on_close = false`, and hand `token` to the system that mints child tokens. Terraform opens an ephemeral resource on every plan and apply, so each run issues a new token; with `revoke_on_close = false` earlier tokens stay valid until `ttl_seconds` passes. Pick a TTL that matches how often you rotate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Issue a short-lived token for one run and hand it to a write-only
# argument; it is revoked when Terraform finishes.
ephemeral "harborpilot_gateway_token" "relay" {
  binding_id  = harborpilot_client_binding.relay.id
  name        = "relay"
  ttl_seconds = 900
}

resource "harborpilot_notification_channel" "relay" {
  name = "relay-webhook"
  spec = jsonencode({
    type        = "webhook"
    webhook_url = "https://relay.example.com/notify"
    enabled     = true
  })
  secrets_wo         = { secret = ephemeral.harborpilot_gateway_token.relay.token }
  secrets_wo_version = 1
}

# A parent token that another system keeps and mints run-scoped child tokens
# from. revoke_on_close = false keeps it valid after the run until it expires.
ephemeral "harborpilot_gateway_token" "parent" {
  binding_id      = harborpilot_client_binding.relay.id
  name            = "parent"
  scopes          = ["gateway:invoke", "gateway:models", "tokens:mint"]
  ttl_seconds     = 30 * 24 * 3600
  revoke_on_close = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `binding_id` (String) Client binding id.

### Optional

- `bound_refs` (Map of String) Trusted external references bound to the token.
- `name` (String) Label (default `terraform-ephemeral`).
- `revoke_on_close` (Boolean) Revoke the token when Terraform closes the ephemeral resource (default `true`). Set to `false` to keep it valid until `ttl_seconds` passes, for a token another system keeps.
- `scopes` (Set of String) Scopes: `gateway:invoke`, `gateway:models`, `usage:read`, `tokens:mint`. Default: `gateway:invoke`, `gateway:models`.
- `ttl_seconds` (Number) Lifetime in seconds (default 3600, at most 63072000, two years). Child tokens minted from it cannot outlive it.

### Read-Only

- `base_urls` (Map of String)
- `credential_id` (String)
- `expires_at` (String)
- `prefix` (String)
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The bearer token.
